name: neuromap-brain-3d
description: Realistic browser-based interactive 3D brain rendered from sourced scan-derived anatomy.

scripts.build: node scripts/validate-disorders.mjs && node scripts/check-functions.mjs && vite build && node scripts/copy-content.mjs
